newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected Moslem militant escapes custody in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected Moslem militant escapes custody in Egypt.

text.p: Egyptian police are searching for a suspected Moslem militant who escaped on Wednesday from the prosecutor's office during a session to extend his detention, security sources said.

They said Hussein Khedr, who is charged with belonging to the militant Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group) and attacking goldsmiths in Cairo, tricked the soldiers guarding him and went into the toilet where he changed into civilian clothes and walked out of the building.
The prosecutor's office said that Khedr's lawyers provided him with the clothes and that his relatives also helped in the escape, the sources added.

More than 1,000 people have been killed and scores more wounded since 1992 when the Gama'a and other Moslem militant groups started their armed campaign to topple Egypt's government and establish a strict Islamic state.
